basic_info.description: At the doorstep of the shops and eateries of Glen Park Village is an exceptional opportunity. Situated on a full sized lot are two structures, a main house and a rear bungalow, both are vacant and in need of restoration. The main house is a 2bd/1ba residence above a 2-car garage. The main house has a fireplace with brick surround & built in book shelves, a formal dining room with access to a side patio, and a full kitchen with adjoining laundry closet and direct yard access. The quaint bungalow is nestled in the yard and is fully detached. On the ground level are two side by side independent garages and storage. Do not miss this Outstanding Buy!!
